founder.bio:
Dozer Napitupulu started DN Tech so clients could talk straight to the person writing the code, instead of through an account manager. He has been building applications and websites since 2017 — HRIS, ERP, and the operational software companies run on. On the projects that decide whether a business ships, he stays hands-on with architecture, code review, and the calls that cannot be delegated.

PT. Dozer Napitupulu Technology is the legal entity behind the studio. Our first-party products are the proof of technical work: what is live is clearly marked, and anything still in beta is never dressed up as a case study.
